add_definitions(-DLANGPACK)
include_directories(include)
spec2def(lpk.dll lpk.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# lpk.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/lpk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(lpk_shims OBJECT bidi.c direction.c lpk.c stub.c)
target_link_libraries(lpk_shims PRIVATE wine libusp10 libversion libuser32 libgdi32 libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(lpk_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(lpk lpk-cargo lpk.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS lpk_shims psdk)
